answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, re-queued for a second panel, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Every claim climbs the nebula of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the quill re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the forge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
